stories.headline: TerraVolt Signs 55,000 MMBTU/Day Natural Gas Deal for Idaho AI Data Center Campus

key_facts.fact: CalEthos and its subsidiary TerraVolt Infrastructure announced a firm natural gas supply agreement for 55,000 MMBTU per day to power a planned behind-the-meter onsite power plant for an AI data center campus in Southeast Idaho.
The first phase of the campus is planned for 200-240 MW of power for data center customers, located on the Northwest Natural Gas Pipeline.

CalEthos says the project aligns with President Trump's March 4, 2026 Ratepayer Protection Pledge, which requires technology companies to pay for the power infrastructure needed to support their expanding data centers.

stories.headline: Cowboy Space (ex-Aetherflux) Raises $275M Series B at $2B for Orbital AI Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Cowboy Space Corporation, founded in 2024 by Robinhood co-founder Baiju Bhatt, announced a $275 million Series B at a $2 billion post-money valuation on May 11, 2026, alongside a rebrand from Aetherflux and a pivot into orbital AI data centers and rockets.
Index Ventures led the round, with participation from IVP, Blossom Capital, SAIC, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, Interlagos and Bhatt himself.

Cowboy plans a launch vehicle whose upper stage doubles as a 1-megawatt data center in orbit, replacing the conventional rocket-plus-payload split; first satellite launches this year and first rocket no earlier than end-2028.

The company pitches itself as a response to terrestrial AI compute and energy constraints, with eventual targets of beaming solar power from low-Earth orbit and running inference for 'big model labs' like OpenAI and Anthropic.

stories.headline: eBay Board Rejects GameStop's $56B Takeover as 'Neither Credible Nor Attractive'

key_facts.fact: eBay's board concluded GameStop's unsolicited $125-per-share, half cash/half stock proposal valuing the company at roughly $56B is 'neither credible nor attractive'.
The board cited eBay's standalone prospects, uncertainty over GameStop's financing, leverage and operational risks of the combined entity, and leadership structure concerns.

GameStop, with a market value around $11–12B and roughly $9.4B in cash and liquid investments, had a 'highly-confident letter' from TD Securities for up to $20B, leaving an unfunded gap of about $16B on the $56B deal.
GameStop's CEO Ryan Cohen had said he is prepared to take the offer directly to shareholders in a proxy fight if eBay's board rejected it.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Bizengri for NRG1-Fusion Bile Duct Cancer, 7th Drug Under Priority Voucher Program

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Partner Therapeutics' Bizengri (zenocutuzumab-zbco) for adults with advanced, unresectable or metastatic NRG1 fusion-positive cholangiocarcinoma after progression on prior therapy — the first targeted therapy for the indication.
Approval was expedited through the FDA Commissioner's National Priority Voucher program — the seventh drug approved under the new pilot.
The decision was based on the open-label, single-arm eNRGy trial of 22 patients (19 evaluable) showing a 36.8% confirmed overall response rate and duration of response of 2.8–12.9 months.
Bizengri previously received accelerated approval in 2024 for NRG1-fusion non-small cell lung cancer and pancreatic adenocarcinoma after prior systemic therapy.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Roche's Ocrevus for Children 10 and Older With Relapsing-Remitting MS

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Roche/Genentech's Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) for children 10 and older weighing at least 25 kg with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis — only the second therapy formally approved for pediatric MS in the US.
Approval rested mainly on the Phase 3 OPERETTA 2 trial in 187 children and adolescents comparing Ocrevus head-to-head with Gilenya (fingolimod) over two years.
Patients on Ocrevus had a 48% lower risk of relapse versus oral Gilenya, with a 48% reduction in new or enlarging lesions and 87% fewer actively inflamed lesions.
No participants discontinued Ocrevus due to side effects in the trial, while three withdrew on Gilenya; the safety profile was consistent with adult experience.

stories.headline: Google Says It Thwarted First Known AI-Built Zero-Day Aimed at Mass Exploitation

key_facts.fact: Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) said on May 11, 2026 it had, for the first time, identified a threat actor using a zero-day exploit it believes was developed with help from an AI model, intended for a 'mass exploitation event' that GTIG says it may have disrupted before launch.
The bug was a two-factor authentication bypass in a popular open-source web-based system administration tool, implemented in a Python script that GTIG quietly disclosed and helped patch.

Tell-tale signs that an LLM helped write the exploit, per Google, included a 'hallucinated' CVSS score, educational docstrings, and a 'structured, textbook Pythonic format' characteristic of LLM-training data.
GTIG ruled out that Gemini was used and did not name which model was used, but said the flaw type — a high-level semantic logic bug — is the kind 'AI systems excel at identifying.'

GTIG also flagged that PRC- and DPRK-linked actors are showing 'significant interest' in using AI for vulnerability discovery, and that adversaries are increasingly targeting AI systems themselves, including autonomous skills and third-party data connectors.

stories.headline: Helsing Nears $1.2B Round at $18B Valuation, Led by Dragoneer and Lightspeed

key_facts.fact: Munich-based defense-AI startup Helsing is closing in on a roughly $1.2 billion funding round at about an $18 billion valuation, led by US firm Dragoneer Investment Group and co-led by existing investor Lightspeed Venture Partners.
The round, first reported by the Financial Times, was 'oversubscribed multiple times' and is at an advanced stage, though timing is not yet finalised.
Helsing's previous round, in June 2025, was a €600 million investment led by Daniel Ek at an estimated €12 billion valuation (~$14 billion).

Founded in 2021, Helsing started building AI software for defense firms and pivoted to designing drones after Russia's invasion of Ukraine; its AI is designed to be hardware-agnostic and runs on platforms from the Eurofighter Typhoon to autonomous land vehicles.

stories.headline: Helsing Closing $1.2B Round at $18B Valuation, Largest German Startup Raise on Record

key_facts.fact: Munich-based defense AI startup Helsing is closing on a $1.2B funding round led by Dragoneer Investment Group with existing backer Lightspeed Venture Partners as co-lead, at an ~$18B valuation.
The new valuation is roughly 30% above the €12B (~$14B) implied in Helsing's June 2025 Series D led by Daniel Ek's Prima Materia.
The round would be the largest ever raised by a German startup, eclipsing Celonis's $1B in 2021 and N26's $900M the same year.
Despite US firms leading the round, Helsing remains roughly 80% European-owned, positioning it as a sovereign European alternative to Anduril.
The round was reportedly oversubscribed multiple times and comes amid an active €1.46B drone contract with the German military.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang Left Off Trump's China Trip Delegation; Musk, Cook, Boeing CEO Invited

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was not invited to join President Trump on his China trip this week, while Elon Musk, Apple's Tim Cook, GE Aerospace's Larry Culp and Boeing's Kelly Ortberg will travel with the president.
A White House source said Huang was not invited because the trip is focused on agriculture and commercial aviation matters such as Boeing aircraft orders.
Huang told CNBC the previous week he would gladly join if invited; he has identified China as a $50 billion opportunity for Nvidia AI chip sales.

Nvidia's H200 chips were approved by Commerce in recent weeks under a 25% revenue-sharing arrangement, but Commerce Secretary Lutnick said on April 22 that no shipments had actually moved because Chinese buyers have not received permission from Beijing to import them.

stories.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Not Invited on Trump's China Trip as White House Pivots to Boeing, Soybeans

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was not invited to join President Trump's May 13–15 trip to Beijing, a person familiar with the matter said.
The White House delegation is focused on agriculture and commercial aviation deliverables — including potential Boeing aircraft orders and large Chinese soybean, beef and poultry purchases.

Confirmed CEO travel companions include Elon Musk (Tesla), Tim Cook (Apple), Larry Fink (BlackRock), Kelly Ortberg (Boeing), Larry Culp (GE Aerospace), Jane Fraser (Citigroup) and Cristiano Amon (Qualcomm).

Trump previously cleared Nvidia's H200 AI chips for export to China, but Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said on April 22 that no sales have occurred because Chinese buyers lack permission from Beijing.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged China to pressure Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, accusing Beijing of 'funding terrorism' by continuing to buy Iranian oil.

stories.headline: Nscale Secures $790M Debt Financing for Narvik AI Data Center in Norway

key_facts.fact: Nscale announced $790 million in additional debt financing committed by ABN AMRO, DNB, Eksfin, Nordea and SEB to develop its AI data center in Narvik, Norway — described as the country's largest AI infrastructure investment.
The package includes an additional $790 million accordion feature to fund a further 115 MW expansion at the Narvik campus.
The Narvik site was previously earmarked for OpenAI's Stargate Norway project; after that deal fell through, Nscale signed with Microsoft, which will rent Nvidia GPUs at the site.
The Microsoft deal adds more than 30,000 Nvidia Rubin GPUs to the Narvik campus, to be delivered by 2027.
Nscale was valued at $14.6 billion earlier this year after a $2 billion Series C, and previously secured a $1.4 billion delayed-draw term loan in February 2026.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches 'Daybreak' Cyber-Defense Initiative With GPT-5.5 and Codex Security

key_facts.fact: OpenAI on May 11, 2026 unveiled 'Daybreak,' a cybersecurity initiative pairing frontier OpenAI models with Codex (its agentic harness) and security partners to accelerate cyber defense and 'continuously secure software.'

Daybreak introduces tiered model access for defenders, including 'GPT-5.5 with Trusted Access for Cyber' for routine defensive workflows and a more permissive 'GPT-5.5-Cyber' tier with stronger verification, gated for authorized red-teaming and penetration-testing.

Alongside Daybreak, OpenAI moved Codex Security (formerly Aardvark) into a research preview, rolling out via Codex web to ChatGPT Pro, Enterprise, Business and Edu customers with free usage for the next month.
OpenAI says Codex Security cut noise on repeated scans by 84% in one case, reduced over-reported severity findings by more than 90%, and lowered false-positive rates by over 50%.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches $4B Deployment Company, Acquires Consulting Firm Tomoro

key_facts.fact: OpenAI on May 11, 2026 launched 'OpenAI Deployment Company,' a majority-owned and -controlled new entity to help large enterprises build and deploy AI, capitalised with more than $4 billion of initial investment from a consortium of 19 investment firms, consultancies and system integrators.
TPG is leading the consortium, with Advent International, Bain Capital and Brookfield as co-lead founding partners; Goldman Sachs, SoftBank Corp., Warburg Pincus and BBVA also participate.

Alongside the launch, OpenAI agreed to acquire Tomoro, a London-based applied AI consultancy founded in 2023, bringing roughly 150 Forward Deployed Engineers and Deployment Specialists into the new entity from day one. Tomoro's clients include Tesco, Virgin Atlantic, Mattel, Red Bull and Supercell.
The Tomoro acquisition price was not disclosed and is expected to close in the coming months, subject to regulatory approvals.

Industry analysts cited estimate Deployment Company could eventually reach 2,000 to 4,000 deployment engineers within three years, supporting a multi-billion-dollar annual run rate before customer revenue.

stories.headline: OpenAI-Microsoft Revenue Share Capped at $38B vs. $135B Earlier Trajectory

key_facts.fact: OpenAI and Microsoft have agreed to cap total revenue-sharing payments at $38 billion, The Information reported on May 11, 2026, citing a person with knowledge of the arrangement.

Under the prior terms, OpenAI's payments to Microsoft could have totaled roughly $135 billion through 2030 if long-term goals were met; the new cap is part of the partnership amendment unveiled in late April.
Payments will continue through 2030 at the previously agreed 20% rate, independent of any OpenAI declaration of AGI, but now subject to the overall cap.
Investors expect the cap to strengthen OpenAI's IPO pitch; some executives have said an offering could come as soon as end-2026.
The April amendment also ended Microsoft's exclusivity and stopped Microsoft's reverse revenue-share payments to OpenAI; Microsoft retains roughly 27% of OpenAI's for-profit arm.

stories.headline: Reliance to Get 900+ Acres in Andhra Pradesh for 1.5 GW Hyperscale AI Data Center

key_facts.fact: The Andhra Pradesh government has agreed in principle to allot more than 900 acres near Bhogapuram International Airport to Reliance Industries for what will be India's largest AI-ready hyperscale data center cluster at 1.5 GW.
The investment is valued at ₹1.6 lakh crore (~$19 billion), with formal clearance expected soon after approval from the State Investment Promotion Board.

Reliance requested ~360 acres for phase one and 635 acres for phase two, plus additional land for a cable landing station and desalination plant. Power will come from captive solar generation and battery energy storage.
The Reliance project follows the groundbreaking of Google's $15 billion, 1 GW data center at Taruluvada near Visakhapatnam, being developed with AdaniConneX and Nxtra by Airtel.

stories.headline: China's Robotera Raises Over $200M Led by SF Group to Scale Humanoid Robotics

key_facts.fact: Beijing-based Robotera raised over $200 million in a new round led by SF Group, with participation from HSG, IDG Capital, Hillhouse Investment, CICC Capital and several industrial partners including KENGIC, Dongfeng Asset Investment, ICBC Capital and funds affiliated with China Unicom.

Robotera says it has reached the first product-market fit in embodied intelligence, with deployments across more than ten logistics centers in collaboration with China Post and SF Group; Q2 2026 saw thousand-unit deliveries with growth exceeding 300%.

Founded in August 2023 by Chen Jianyu, Robotera sells the L7 full-size bipedal humanoid (~171 cm), the STAR 1 model tested in the Gobi Desert and Great Wall, and the ERA-42 end-to-end embodied AI model.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines Unveils 'Interaction Models' for Real-Time Audio/Video AI

key_facts.fact: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab announced a research preview of 'interaction models' on May 11, 2026 — a new class of natively multimodal AI that processes audio, video and text in continuous 200ms micro-turns, listening, watching and responding simultaneously instead of in turn-taking style.
The lead system, TML-Interaction-Small, is a 276-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 12B active parameters, paired with a separate deeper-reasoning module to handle slower thinking.
On the FD-bench interaction benchmark, the model reports a turn-taking latency of 0.40 seconds vs. 0.57s for Gemini-3.1-flash-live and 1.18s for GPT-realtime-2.0 (minimal).
Thinking Machines will open a limited research preview to collect feedback in the coming months and plans a wider release later this year; the model is not yet publicly available.
Demos showed the model backchanneling during human speech, translating speech live, noticing a user slouching, and flagging an animal mentioned in a story.

stories.headline: US-Brokered Ukraine-Russia Three-Day Truce Expires; Drone Strikes Resume After Midnight

key_facts.fact: The three-day US-mediated ceasefire that ran from May 9 to May 11 expired after midnight on May 12, with Russian and Ukrainian monitoring channels reporting combat drone launches resuming almost immediately.
Zelensky said on May 11 that Russia is preparing new attacks and reported the Ukrainian general staff had logged 133 attacks and nearly 5,000 drone launches across the front during the truce period.
Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha proposed Europe broker an 'airport ceasefire' restricting strikes on each side's airfields, after US-led talks stalled amid the Iran war.
Zelensky said Ukrainian negotiator Rustem Umerov met US envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Florida and discussed 'possible formats of meetings at the leadership level' to end the war.

stories.headline: Vbot Raises ~$73M Pre-A, Sets Consumer Embodied AI Funding Record in China

key_facts.fact: Chinese embodied AI startup Vbot closed a Pre-A round of nearly 500 million yuan (~$73 million), co-led by Oriental Fortune Capital, Huatai Zijin Investment and Fosun RZ Capital, with participation from SAIC Motor's Shangqi Capital. The company calls it the largest single-round consumer embodied intelligence funding to date.
Vbot started shipping its first product — the Vbot Super Robot Dog — on May 8, with the first batch of 500 units mass-produced and now being delivered through WeChat mini-program and JD.com.
Vbot plans to increase production capacity to more than 2,500 units per month in June and will begin development of a full-size humanoid robot, including an Agentic OS for embodied applications.
Vbot was founded in late 2024 by Dr. Yu Yinan, who previously led work in autonomous driving at Horizon Robotics, and produces its robot dog to automotive-industry standards with 5-hour battery life.
Yicai Global reports the round as part of a broader surge: Vbot, Lumos Robotics and Uncharted Dynamics together raised nearly 1 billion yuan (~$137 million) in fresh funding announced this week.
